subject: Electrical Engineering
title: Vehicle-to-Grid: Cars as Batteries
description: A fast breakdown of Vehicle-to-Grid: Cars as Batteries for builders.

hook.text: Your electric car has a 60 kWh battery. It sits parked 95% of the time.

buildup.text: Vehicle-to-grid lets the car feed power back during peak demand — and get paid.

discovery.text: A million cars could provide more storage than all the world's grid batteries today.

twist.text: Extra charge-discharge cycles degrade the car's battery faster. Owners worry about lifespan.

climax.text: Smart charging software limits degradation while still earning grid income.

punchline.text: Park the car, power the grid, get paid. Everybody wins.

quiz.question: What is the main concern about vehicle-to-grid technology?
options: Cars don't have enough battery capacity to matter
Extra charge-discharge cycles may degrade the car battery faster
Electric vehicles use different voltage than the grid
